2608.10330.title: Hierarchical Compositionality for An Assistive AI Agent
2608.10330.paper_summary: AI agents are increasingly being developed to assist humans in various applications, and Large Language Models and other deep network architectures are considered to be state of the art for such agents. These methods are impressive stochastic predictors, but they are resource-hungry, opaque, and known to make arbitrary decisions in novel situations due to the narrow set of underlying representation and processing choices. Our work seeks to explore the design of architectures for such AI agents based on core principles that can be traced back to the early pioneers of AI but are not fully utilized in modern AI methods. We do so in this paper in the context of the core problem of AI agents addressing ambiguity in the objects being referred to by the human participants. Humans address such ambiguity by heuristically leveraging compositional knowledge of domain context and the preferences of the other human participants. Drawing inspiration from this observation, we describe an architecture that embeds the principle of hierarchical compositionality and uses simple heuristics to achieve the desired disambiguation. Specifically, domain objects are represented in terms of primitive attributes drawn from human-validated semantic feature norms, and a hierarchical combination of attributes and concepts automatically identified from a limited observed history of interactions of an assistive agent with specific users. The assistive agent then achieves the desired disambiguation by reasoning with knowledge of this compositional hierarchy; axioms governing domain dynamics; and models of semantic compatibility, session salience, and user-specific thematic preference, requesting human clarification when necessary. Experiments show that our approach consistently outperforms state of the art data-driven baselines, supporting adaptation to specific user profiles.
2608.10330.paper_summary_zh: AI 代理人正日益被開發以協助人類在各種應用中，而大型語言模型和其他深度網絡架構被認為是此類代理人的最先進技術。這些方法是令人印象深刻的隨機預測器，但它們資源需求高、透明度低，並且因為基礎表示和處理選擇的狹窄範圍而在新情況下會做出任意的決策。我們的工作旨在探索基於核心原則的 AI 代理人架構設計，這些原則可以追溯到 AI 的早期先驅，但在現代 AI 方法中並未得到充分利用。我們在本文中探討了 AI 代理人解決人類參與者所提及物體的模糊性這一核心問題。人類通過啟發式地利用領域上下文的組合知識和其他人類參與者的偏好來解決這種模糊性。受到這一觀察的啟發，我們描述了一種嵌入層次組合性原則的架構，並使用簡單的啟發式方法來實現所需的消歧義。具體而言，領域對象是根據從人類驗證的語義特徵標準中提取的原始屬性來表示的，並且從輔助代理人與特定用戶的有限觀察互動歷史中自動識別的屬性和概念的層次組合。然後，輔助代理人通過利用這一組合層次的知識、支配領域動態的公理以及語義相容性、會話顯著性和用戶特定主題偏好的模型來實現所需的消歧義，並在必要時請求人類澄清。實驗表明，我們的方法在性能上始終優於最先進的數據驅動基準，支持對特定用戶檔案的適應。
